gloss: ability to memorize; powers of rote memory

definitions.gloss: ability to memorize; powers of rote memory
definitions.explanation: The capacity to commit material to memory by heart, especially vocabulary, formulas, or facts for an examination. Discussed mainly in the context of studying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{暗記力|あんきりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: She has a good memory for facts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とって{暗記力|あんきりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧きた。
examples.english: As I've gotten older, my ability to memorize has declined.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{受|う}かる→受かる：19367_ukaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{暗記力|あんきりょく}⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{理解|りかい}する→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Passing the exam requires not just the ability to memorize but the ability to understand.

notes:
⟦{暗記|あんき}→暗記：01701_anki⟧ (memorization by heart) + {力|りょく} (ability). Narrower than ⟦{記憶力|きおくりょく}→記憶力：17616_kiokuryoku⟧: it is specifically about deliberately learning material by rote.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暗記力|あんきりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ / ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have / lack a good memory for material
- {暗記力|あんきりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧: to train one's memorization ability
- {暗記力|あんきりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: for one's memory to decline

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{記憶力|きおくりょく}→記憶力：17616_kiokuryoku⟧: memory; retentive capacity — broader, covering everything one remembers, not just studied material
- ⟦{理解力|りかいりょく}→理解力：08707_rikairyoku⟧: comprehension — often contrasted with {暗記力|あんきりょく} in discussions of how to study
